task: EQH/EQL Persistent Cluster Identity Design V3

decision.architecture: Immutable cluster base + append-only member ledger + incremental projector

directAnswers.Q1: Minimum schema: stable identity, immutable formation anchor/createdAt/confirmedAt, append-only timestamped members, derived mean reference/memberCount/lastMemberConfirmedAt, and unchanged lifecycle state.
directAnswers.Q2: Create at two qualified members; every later confirmed Swing is appended only when it directly passes frozen Price and Formation gates against the immutable formation anchor and the cluster is ACTIVE.
directAnswers.Q3: Keep the first-formation id forever. Member append never creates a replacement id and never rewrites confirmedAt.
directAnswers.Q4: Maintain an atomic active membership index keyed by side + canonicalSwingId. Creation and append must reserve membership exactly once.
directAnswers.Q5: If more than one active cluster matches, use AMBIGUOUS_UNASSIGNED: append to none and do not create a third overlapping cluster.
directAnswers.Q6: Every appended member must directly pass against the immutable original anchor; validity through another member is forbidden.
directAnswers.Q7: Keep computing the frozen arithmetic mean for referencePrice, but never use that moving mean for append eligibility; use immutable anchor price.
directAnswers.Q8: confirmedAt remains the first two-member formation time. Only lastMemberConfirmedAt/memberAddedAt advance.
directAnswers.Q9: Store memberAddedAt and project members/reference only where memberAddedAt <= evaluationTime.
directAnswers.Q10: Only ACTIVE permits append. TOUCHED, SWEPT and BROKEN do not; terminal clusters never reopen.
directAnswers.Q11: Simultaneous overlap means shared canonical membership among active clusters at the same checkpoint. Historical sequential reuse means a later cluster formed by new Swings after the old cluster is terminal.
directAnswers.Q12: Preserve 2/2 pivots, closed/confirmedAt discipline, lifecycle eligibility for new cluster creation, all Price/Formation thresholds, bounded anchor intent, arithmetic mean reference, lifecycle, Sweep, WATCH, AMD and Notification.
directAnswers.Q13: Defer member-extrema lifecycle, partial member sweep, cluster envelope sweep, lifecycle redesign, merge/split, member-count quality, MTF, volume/OI/order book and all threshold tuning.

DEFERRED_QUESTIONS: Whether TOUCHED clusters should ever become appendable in a later separately audited policy
